# DerivativeCalculus.com

> > Free calculus tools with step-by-step solutions, interactive graphs, and AI tutoring for derivatives, integrals, limits, and advanced calculus topics.

DerivativeCalculus.com is a comprehensive free calculus learning platform founded by Mian Muhammad Asghar, offering 25+ specialized calculators, AI-powered tutoring (CalcMentor™), and extensive educational resources for students from beginner to advanced levels.

## Key Topics

- Derivative Calculator
- Chain Rule

- Integral Calculator

## Core Tools & Calculators

- [Derivative Calculator — Instant Steps, Graph & Rules | Free](https://www.derivativecalculus.com): Free derivative calculator with step-by-step solutions and interactive graphs.

- [Limit Calculator with Steps | Free – L'Hôpital, Taylor, 0/0](https://www.derivativecalculus.com/limit-calculator.html): Limit calculator solving indeterminate forms using L'Hôpital and Taylor series.

## Derivative Rules & Specialized Calculators

- [Product Rule Calculator — (fg)′ = f′g + fg′ | Step-by-Step Free](https://www.derivativecalculus.com/product-rule-calculator.html): Product rule calculator solving (fg)′ = f′g + fg′ with step-by-step work.
- [Quotient Rule Calculator with Steps | Free — No Sign-Up](https://www.derivativecalculus.com/quotient-rule-calculator.html): Free quotient rule calculator for f/g derivatives with full step-by-step work.
- [Interactive Derivative Rules Hub: Master Calculus with Examples & Practice | DerivativeCalculus.com](https://www.derivativecalculus.com/basic-derivative-calculator.html): Interactive hub with 50+ examples of power, chain, product, quotient rules.
